english: Two brothers dwelt together. The two wives drew water from the river. Their husbands were at work; the sun was burning. The wife of one brother spoke to the wife of the other: "You have deceived me." She said: "I did not deceive you." Then the words ran to the husbands. One brother struck the other, and blood came forth. The two women cried out, and the father-in-law heard. He came, and stood between the two. "Let go! What have you done?" Distress filled the household. The two stood, and looked down.
